name: Tooltip
description: The APG tooltip: a description that appears on hover *and* on focus and stays until the user is done with it.

props.name: content
props.description: The description itself. Nothing renders while this is empty.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger, handed the ref and props that wire it to the tooltip.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out and the tooltip owns it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether it starts open, when the tooltip owns its own state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires with the new state and why it changed — `'hover'`, `'focus'`, `'pointer-leave'`, `'blur'` or `'escape'`.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: How long the pointer has to rest on the trigger, in ms. Default 300 — sweeping across a toolbar should not light every control up. Focus ignores it: a keyboard user asked for the tooltip by arriving.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: The grace period after the pointer leaves, in ms. Default 150, so the pointer can reach the tooltip (WCAG 1.4.13).

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger the bubble sits on — `top`/`bottom` are the block axis, `start`/`end` the inline one. Default `'bottom'`, and a side with no room flips to its opposite either way.

props.name: align
props.description: Which of the trigger's edges to line the bubble up with along the other axis. Default `'center'`.

props.name: offset
props.description: The gap between trigger and bubble, on the ÷4 spacing scale. Default 1 — 4px, which is near enough for the pointer to cross without leaving the trigger (WCAG 1.4.13) and far enough to read as a layer.

props.name: flip
props.description: Whether a side with no room may be swapped for its opposite. Default `true`.

keyboard.action: Shows it as soon as the trigger has focus, ignoring `openDelay`: a keyboard user asked for it by arriving.
Hides it, leaving focus on the trigger. It stays hidden until the pointer or focus leaves and comes back.
Reaches the next control, and the tooltip closes behind it.
Shows it after `openDelay`, 300 ms by default: sweeping across a toolbar should not light every control up.
Hides it after `closeDelay`, 150 ms — unless the pointer lands on the tooltip itself.
Keeps it open for as long as the pointer is there, so a long description can be read or selected.

a11y: `role="tooltip"` on the bubble and `aria-describedby` on the trigger, so the description is read as part of the control rather than as text that happens to be nearby.
WCAG 1.4.13, all three parts: Escape dismisses it without moving focus, the pointer can travel onto the bubble and read it, and nothing hides it on a timer.
The bubble is never in the tab order — a focusable tooltip is a dialog with the wrong role — and it renders nothing at all while `content` is empty.
